name: Time Zone Query - ( IANA Time Zone )

map.时区查询是一款旅行出行领域的在线工具。旅行出行工具，出行必备，支持离线使用。: Time Zone Lookup is an online tool for travel. A travel tool that is essential for trips and works offline.
map.输入（IANA 时区名或城市名）: Input (IANA time zone name or city name)
map.📚 深度解析：IANA 时区查询: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: IANA Time Zone Lookup
map.输入「Tokyo」命中 Asia/Tokyo，offset +9，显示当地当前时: Entering "Tokyo" matches Asia/Tokyo with offset +9 and shows the current local time (such as 14:23:05), which is useful for checking itinerary times.
map.输入「lon」命中 Europe/London(offset 0/+1)，单结果: Entering "lon" matches Europe/London (offset 0/+1). A single result goes straight to the detail view, while multiple results list the candidates.
map.偏移含夏令时吗？: Does the offset include daylight saving time?
map.按当前日期实时算，伦敦夏令时 +1、冬令时 0。: It is computed in real time for the current date, so London shows +1 in summer time and 0 in winter time.
map.时区名、UTC 偏移、当地现在时刻，不做未来预约换算。: The time zone name, the UTC offset, and the current local time; no future scheduling conversion is performed.
